channel.title: Suchetana Bauri — Blog
channel.description: Writing on AI enablement, communication and design by Suchetana Bauri.

item.title: OpenPencil review: not another screen generator
item.dc:creator: Suchetana Bauri
item.description: I tested OpenPencil on my own design file. An AI agent cleared the contrast findings in seconds, and left the design-system decision behind them on my desk.

item.title: AI strategy: what is your business for now?
item.dc:creator: Suchetana Bauri
item.description: Lessons from Adobe, DBS and Arizona State University on changing what an organisation offers, how it works and what it must protect.

item.title: Your next AI agent should fix a broken workflow, not invent a new job
item.dc:creator: Suchetana Bauri
item.description: In 2026, enterprises are moving beyond AI that answers questions towards systems that investigate, recommend and act. The opportunity for 2027 is to resolve the work that keeps getting stuck.

item.title: Your AI strategy is quietly rewriting the rules of work
item.dc:creator: Suchetana Bauri
item.description: When AI enters performance reviews, hiring decisions and everyday expectations, a leadership message becomes something more consequential. Before 2027, organisations need to explain the bargain they are asking employees to accept.

item.title: The interface owes you an explanation
item.dc:creator: Suchetana Bauri
item.description: The foundational UI/UX thinkers who shape how I approach design, communication and AI: Norman, Nielsen, Shneiderman, Krug, Garrett, Rosenfeld and Morville.

item.title: I stopped asking AI to write my marketing. I started redesigning the work.
item.dc:creator: Suchetana Bauri
item.description: How moving from prompts to context, bounded agents and connected workflows changed my digital marketing practice, and why editorial judgement matters more, not less.

item.title: Before you change the logo, find out what people think you do
item.dc:creator: Suchetana Bauri
item.description: A rebrand should close the distance between what a business has become and what people understand it to be. That requires decisions about the business itself.

item.title: Thought leadership is not a writing problem
item.dc:creator: Suchetana Bauri
item.description: What translating research at ISB, specialist knowledge at ELMS and internal communication at Microsoft (via partner) taught me about turning expertise into something people can use.
